Thénardier avança un peu la tête.", "sha256": "5dc41b647fa8a866d66a3393fc0d2b425689c394ab345323bb580b494f1a0d29", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0065", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vite ! dit Montparnasse, as-tu l’autre bout de la corde, Brujon ?", "sha256": "88dc56fe576966d6b04135e8bbd7b2af2ba7e8d4d94efd9616791b01c57a9a09", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0066", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui. — Noue les deux bouts ensemble, nous lui jetterons la corde, il la fixera au mur, il en aura assez pour descendre.", "sha256": "7c8685eb16482c0688447a7731622ac6cb84752c6e592a978847f29cec5d6497", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0067", "tag": "prose", "text": "Thénardier se risqua à élever la voix.", "sha256": "2079b0dfccfbded8e22097303b62fc3fce9352a5df94caa90147982a642e21d3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0068", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je suis transi.", "sha256": "3e74244ccfd8403bd6b008059e84488182b2d72bcd91cc77813ccff10fcced4e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0069", "tag": "prose", "text": "— On te réchauffera.", "sha256": "c31959c56840dea20628bc3591358eebda4c217b77e9fbba43857feb968fa3e8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0070", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je ne puis plus bouger.", "sha256": "f8fb0e33d5386af8f18b6de8e85e79e82ad493a2003e9e319114fdfcb3c9ea45", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0071", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tu te laisseras glisser, nous te recevrons.", "sha256": "c5e64d62f18fed724b9367969d67d50f9db99f441b4e3f434cc55421e00dfceb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0072", "tag": "prose", "text": "— J’ai les mains gourdes.", "sha256": "5e1b0c12aa733259ed18b8c441e955de001088c971b01b5f26d50d93d6aad512", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0073", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Noue seulement la corde au mur.", "sha256": "264c0e062a3e7f654d397ac1d0e4994a8e67b0018a6542ed965b68cd4e396729", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0074", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je ne pourrai pas.", "sha256": "b4e4a8f8b878e321fed36138f1058c4e5da656edb19ffc03c104a553f1e37f13", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0075", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il faut que l’un de nous monte, dit Montparnasse.", "sha256": "450fa473c77a7d72c3e5714fed605f7d5930032e3de60373f98aedd8e622026c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0076", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Trois étages ! fit Brujon.", "sha256": "274e9b748b7069c901116f6f2ff88384b61777b3fcd4359fd2a787431d883a6d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0077", "tag": "prose", "text": "Un ancien conduit en plâtre, lequel avait servi à un poêle qu’on allumait jadis dans la baraque, rampait le long du mur et montait presque jusqu’à l’endroit où l’on apercevait Thénardier. Ce tuyau, alors fort lézardé et tout crevassé, est tombé depuis, mais on en voit encore les traces. Il était fort étroit.", "sha256": "421e8f5f8597df2cfc03a3098e66429a9afb8d0a0651110387f162ef4fbeaa29", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0078", "tag": "prose", "text": "— On pourrait monter par là, fit Montparnasse.", "sha256": "da9eecd61be6b8a268c9ecece38b15692627af0d8e7b50b7e9e998cf00a449da", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0079", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Par ce tuyau ? s’écria Babel, un orgue[[N9]] jamais ! il faudrait un mion[[N10]].", "sha256": "23e28e257811f4dcf7220f9f9f24464228b6c6eba37333b145cd6d0e6ed647c9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N9]]", "[[N10]]"]}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0080", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il faudrait un môme[[N11]], reprit Brujon.", "sha256": "e9338c73a7a4b6c4b1f4ce964003a5355a5da494d66b66e68189c8f70a3b3ee8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N11]]"]}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0081", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Où trouver un moucheron ? dit Gueulemer.", "sha256": "eb0979b71e6e4e8d1f87a0e63545dc658df0fdab06d708775aa9cb8bf5788ebd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0082", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Attendez, dit Montparnasse. J’ai l’affaire.", "sha256": "e86773f3a0ad78eae4920818f204c311fdfe8bdbb30f3463c321efcffc5f1cc5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0083", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il entr’ouvrit doucement la porte de la palissade, s’assura qu’aucun passant ne traversait la rue, sortit avec précaution, referma la porte derrière lui, et partit en courant dans la direction de la Bastille.", "sha256": "c797a365ddefe6c5e63635219c69a51d72c77390620fa39bb4de1ab784ad273c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0084", "tag": "prose", "text": "Sept ou huit minutes s’écoulèrent, huit mille siècles, pour Thénardier ; Babet, Brujon et Gueulemer ne desserraient pas les dents ; la porte se rouvrit enfin, et Montparnasse parut, essoufflé, et amenant Gavroche. La pluie continuait de faire la rue complètement déserte.", "sha256": "d09c919a0314e016a2602a158ca85be10423360d789442437a43a5a345743861", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0085", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le petit Gavroche entra dans l’enceinte et regarda ces figures de bandits d’un air tranquille. L’eau lui dégouttait des cheveux. Gueulemer lui adressa la parole.", "sha256": "48ba1fc5f58c761c3927f258c6702c5a138444854524e48f44076486fc5f8c11", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0086", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mioche, es-tu un homme ?", "sha256": "a6cfd9aaee0d5bfa3c900f65684dd41b182facc50a875836c0fc933892fed609", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0087", "tag": "prose", "text": "Gavroche haussa les épaules et répondit :", "sha256": "b118c689400e33970789f25708e4321e8b54ab1cd23a59cba407bf1922e0fc75", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0088", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Un môme comme mézig est un orgue, et des orgues comme vousailles sont des mômes[[N12]].", "sha256": "d13a02599a8246016abaf5c7a168126e9a62c98e9b02441ffcdc510f2f7cc74a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N12]]"]}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0089", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comme le mion joue du crachoir[[N13]] ! s’écria Babet.", "sha256": "0e5b387433fa691ec645beadf44a0b6bf4a13240befd90f68533e81af2f2f855", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N13]]"]}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0090", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Le môme pantinois n’est pas maquillé de fertille lansquinée[[N14]], ajouta Brujon.", "sha256": "11866302e6975aa405509692a13ccd3fc9e83004298c3e2a758558ab442b6d55", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N14]]"]}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0091", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut ? dit Gavroche.", "sha256": "5be390f361e010b1f7a7fc7f0df6288b0397b9f3535759bc218fe367905fd03c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0092", "tag": "prose", "text": "Montparnasse répondit :", "sha256": "edd559351bbf582f6f8aa9fa0f643bf12761fa4bb8c1068c6e8dfb135c92f0e9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0093", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Grimper par ce tuyau.", "sha256": "da064a4f7479084d5066ad416cc4b9dec77de0d4cc3b39f99c34108e2a35f135", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0094", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Avec cette veuve[[N15]], fit Babet.", "sha256": "ece3e8291a1ff3c71064cd5b75e57b6da2206daafb4e665ea35c0688b627dade", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N15]]"]}, {"id": "fr81-u252-r0095", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et ligoter la tortouse[[N16]], continua Brujon.", "sha256": "b3c24d34aaf4be7ea915faef4e53e84433e6f2c5f16ce8dc1139425c0787be5e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N16]]"]}]}
